shortDescription: Resource module for managing users and roles in Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: config
options.description: A dictionary containing the configuration details for users or roles.

options.name: config_verify
options.description: Set to True to verify the Cisco Catalyst Center after applying the playbook config.

options.name: dnac_api_task_timeout
options.description: Defines the timeout in seconds for API calls to retrieve task details. If the task details are not received within this period, the process will end, and a timeout notification will be logged.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Indicates whether debugging is enabled in the Cisco Catalyst Center SDK.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The hostname of the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: dnac_log
options.description: Flag to enable/disable playbook execution logging. When true and dnac_log_file_path is provided, - Create the log file at the execution location with the specified name. When true and dnac_log_file_path is not provided, - Create the log file at the execution location with the name 'dnac.log'. When false, - Logging is disabled. If the log file doesn't exist, - It is created in append or write mode based on the "dnac_log_append" flag. If the log file exists, - It is overwritten or appended based o

options.name: dnac_log_append
options.description: Determines the mode of the file. Set to True for 'append' mode. Set to False for 'write' mode.

options.name: dnac_log_file_path
options.description: Governs logging. Logs are recorded if dnac_log is True. If path is not specified, - When 'dnac_log_append' is True, 'dnac.log' is generated in the current Ansible directory; logs are appended. - When 'dnac_log_append' is False, 'dnac.log' is generated; logs are overwritten. If path is specified, - When 'dnac_log_append' is True, the file opens in append mode. - When 'dnac_log_append' is False, the file opens in write (w) mode. - In shared file scenarios, without append mode, content is overwritt

options.name: dnac_log_level
options.description: Sets the threshold for log level. Messages with a level equal to or higher than this will be logged. Levels are listed in order of severity [CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG]. CRITICAL indicates serious errors halting the program. Displays only CRITICAL messages. ERROR indicates problems preventing a function. Displays ERROR and CRITICAL messages. WARNING indicates potential future issues. Displays WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL messages. INFO tracks normal operation. Displays INFO, WARNING, ERRO

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The password for authentication at the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: Specifies the port number associated with the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: dnac_task_poll_interval
options.description: Specifies the interval in seconds between successive calls to the API to retrieve task details.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The username for authentication at the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Specifies the version of the Cisco Catalyst Center that the SDK should use.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of Cisco Catalyst Center after module completion.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
